profile.overview: Witherbloom College is a black-green college associated with Arcavios / Strixhaven.
profile.philosophy: Life and death are living essences to study and use through brewing, healing, harm, death-facing magic, and practical craft.
profile.core_tension: Witherbloom splits between cultivating life energy and extracting it for personal or practical power.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guides frame Witherbloom as the College of Essence Studies, with study areas including alchemy, medicine, biomancy, pathology, toxicology, mortuary science, and necromancy.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Witherbloom identity can use life gain, life loss, Pests, sacrifice, healing, harm, and death triggers when those mechanics express embodied life/death exchange.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
Novel-level or story-episode-specific details should be added in a later deep-dive pass with direct story citations.
